spec.label: microsoft-surface-7 · random-idle run 9
spec.notes: Every node is one of the catalog's types with equal odds (networking types too), then one of that type's images with equal odds; the SIEM (Wazuh manager) is left out: each one downloads and unpacks Wazuh's CVE feed (~2-3 GB of disk), which made Docker's disk, not memory, the limit; switches and routers draw from their own pools (routers must forward, so no default-drop firewalls there). Idle, no traffic. Adaptive: climbs to this mix's ceiling. Run several times with different seeds: some mixes come out heavier than others, on purpose.
